import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, cap, rev;
        Edge(int t, int c, int r) {
            to = t;
            cap = c;
            rev = r;
        }
    }

    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static final int MAX_NODES = 210;

    static List<Edge>[] graph = new List[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] level = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] iter = new int[MAX_NODES];

    static void add_edge(int from, int to, int capacity) {
        graph[from].add(new Edge(to, capacity, graph[to].size()));
        graph[to].add(new Edge(from, 0, graph[from].size() - 1));
    }

    static void bfs(int s) {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        level[s] = 0;
        q.offer(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : graph[u]) {
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] < 0) {
                    level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int t, int f) {
        if (u == t) return f;
        for (; iter[u] < graph[u].size(); ++iter[u]) {
            Edge e = graph[u].get(iter[u]);
            if (e.cap > 0 && level[u] < level[e.to]) {
                int d = dfs(e.to, t, Math.min(f, e.cap));
                if (d > 0) {
                    e.cap -= d;
                    graph[e.to].get(e.rev).cap += d;
                    return d;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int max_flow(int s, int t) {
        int flow = 0;
        while (true) {
            bfs(s);
            if (level[t] < 0) return flow;
            Arrays.fill(iter, 0);
            int f;
            while ((f = dfs(s, t, INF)) > 0) {
                flow += f;
            }
        }
    }

    static final int[][] DIRS = {{0,1},{0,-1},{1,0},{-1,0}};

    static int n, T, source, sink;
    static int[][] cap_grid = new int[15][15];
    static int[][] sci_grid = new int[15][15];
    static int[][][] maze = new int[65][15][15];
    static boolean[][] visited = new boolean[15][15];
    static boolean[][][][][] reach = new boolean[65][15][15][15][15];

    static int get_id(int x, int y, int k) {
        return (x-1)*n + y + k*n*n;
    }

    static void dfs_reach(int sx, int sy, int x, int y, int step) {
        visited[x][y] = true;
        reach[step][sx][sy][x][y] = true;
        if (step >= T || maze[step][x][y] != 0) return;
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
            int nx = x + DIRS[d][0], ny = y + DIRS[d][1];
            if (nx < 1 || ny < 1 || nx > n || ny > n) continue;
            if (visited[nx][ny] || maze[step][nx][ny] != 0) continue;
            dfs_reach(sx, sy, nx, ny, step + 1);
        }
    }

    static void preprocess() {
        for (int t = 1; t <= T; ++t) {
            for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x) {
                for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y) {
                    if (maze[t-1][x][y] != 0) {
                        maze[t][x][y] = maze[t-1][x][y];
                    } else {
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int nx = x + DIRS[d][0], ny = y + DIRS[d][1];
                            if (nx < 1 || ny < 1 || nx > n || ny > n) continue;
                            if (maze[t-1][nx][ny] == 2) {
                                maze[t][x][y] = 2;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (sci_grid[i][j] != 0) {
                    for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x) {
                        Arrays.fill(visited[x], false);
                    }
                    dfs_reach(i, j, i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int t = 1; t <= T; ++t) {
            for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x) {
                for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y) {
                    for (int xx = 1; xx <= n; ++xx) {
                        for (int yy = 1; yy <= n; ++yy) {
                            reach[t][x][y][xx][yy] = reach[t][x][y][xx][yy] || reach[t-1][x][y][xx][yy];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String s = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                char c = s.charAt(j-1);
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) sci_grid[i][j] = c - '0';
                else if (c == 'Y') maze[0][i][j] = 1;
                else if (c == 'Z') maze[0][i][j] = 2;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String s = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                char c = s.charAt(j-1);
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) cap_grid[i][j] = c - '0';
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NODES; ++i) {
            graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        source = n*n*2;
        sink = source - 1;
        preprocess();

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (sci_grid[i][j] != 0) add_edge(source, get_id(i,j,0), sci_grid[i][j]);
                if (cap_grid[i][j] != 0) add_edge(get_id(i,j,1), sink, cap_grid[i][j]);
            }
        }

        for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x) {
            for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y) {
                for (int xx = 1; xx <= n; ++xx) {
                    for (int yy = 1; yy <= n; ++yy) {
                        if (sci_grid[x][y] != 0 && cap_grid[xx][yy] != 0 && reach[T][x][y][xx][yy]) {
                            add_edge(get_id(x,y,0), get_id(xx,yy,1), INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(max_flow(source, sink));
    }
}
